kjv: which is given for you: this do in remembrance of me (Jesus)
mine: [which is given for you … poured out for you]
note: Both print 22:19b–20; SBLGNT brackets it because Codex Bezae and some Old Latin omit it (the "Western non-interpolation"). Most scholars now accept it.

kjv: And the Lord said, Simon, Simon
note: TR adds an introductory "And the Lord said".

kjv: And there appeared an angel unto him (Jesus) from heaven, strengthening him.
mine: [[And there appeared to Him (Jesus) an angel from heaven …]]
note: 22:43–44 (the angel and the bloody sweat) are absent from P75, Vaticanus, A, W and others; SBLGNT double-brackets them as a very early addition. The KJV prints them without mark.

kjv: they struck him (Jesus) on the face, and asked him
mine: blindfolded Him (Jesus) and kept asking Him
note: TR adds "they struck him on the face" from Mk 14:65.

kjv: ye (the council) will not answer me (Jesus), nor let [me] go
note: TR adds "me, nor let me go".
